artifact_gate.source_revision: the exact merged PR 344 commit, built by commit tag
artifact_gate.image_reference: resolve that commit tag to an immutable ECR sha256 digest and pin the task definition to the digest
artifact_gate.preflight_acceptance: stdout runtime_contract must equal required_runtime_contract and ready must be true

existing_job.container_source: copy image, roles, environment, secrets, network and logging from the deployed gateway task definition

checkpoint.overlap_policy: one active lease per agent and index, acquired by etag CAS before the repair engine
checkpoint.renewal_policy: renew by etag CAS before every embedding or projection write dispatch; stop the worker when renewal fails

execute_budget.actual_new_embedding_texts: dry-run fetched count after exact OpenSearch existence checks
execute_budget.approval_gate: review one durable dry run before the first manual execute

activation_order: build the exact merged PR 344 commit tag and resolve its immutable ECR sha256 digest
register a digest-pinned task definition revision with the preflight command
run preflight and require ready true, exit code zero, and runtime_contract historical-repair-durable-fenced-v2
run the durable dry run, verify fetched is at most 25, and retain the prior durable checkpoint
register the execute command only after reviewing dry-run counts and the maximum 25 new embedding texts
keep the schedule disabled until one bounded execute pass and its persisted checkpoint are verified
